comment: Measure this machine's speeds before designing an experiment. Every slot is short on purpose: the table of `pravaha schedule probe_rates.json` gives seconds and GB/s per slot, and you size the real slots from those rates (count = seconds x rate / bytes per operation).

slots.name: read_resident_8mib
slots.comment: 8 MiB fits the 24 MiB GPU L2: after the first pass the cache serves the reads

slots.name: read_streaming_1024mib
slots.comment: 1 GiB is far larger than L2: every byte comes from memory (same 16 GiB of work as above)

slots.name: sham_noop_10ms
slots.comment: empty GPU calls: the cost of the submission loop with no data
